name: approval
description: The model asks for a danger-full-access sandbox escalation; the user approves it from Emacs.

arguments.justification: Demonstrate the approval prompt end to end

steps.observe: The DSH-View ends with an "Awaiting approval for bash" note, not "(continuing...)".
Press `A` — the approval buffer opens with the tool, reason, and arguments.
Press `y` to allow once; the view refills with "Escalation granted; the command ran." and no marker.
